answer: Require one Series 7 securities licence per identity, earned by passing the exam under firm sponsorship after months of study. Each fake costs about $245 in exam fees plus a sponsored trainee, so 1,000 fakes cost $245,000 and 1,000 trained people. An orchard of licences cannot be faked overnight, a beacon of exam records exposes duplicates, and no paper identity survives the background check at the wharf.
